look:mean.what: mean of per-shot DINOv2 CLS vectors

look:mean+std.what: per-shot CLS: mean and per-dimension std, concatenated

look:profile8.what: per-shot CLS: mean within each of 8 equal slices of the sampled running time, concatenated

look:patchmean.what: mean over shots of the mean patch token

look_grid.what: mean of DINOv2 CLS over the every-20-s frame set

colour.what: every-20-s frames: mean and std over frames of 6 light/colour statistics (12), mean 8-bin luminance histogram (8), mean 12-bin chroma-weighted hue histogram gated off when mean saturation < 0.08 (12); z-scored across films

time.what: hand-built shot-length, cutting-rate and motion-energy terms, z-scored across films

motion:mid:mean.what: mean over clips of the V-JEPA 2 ViT-L embedding at about 65% depth, 16 frames from the middle of up to 200 shots

motion:mid:mean+std.what: mean and per-dimension std over clips of the same embedding

motion:last:mean.what: mean over clips of the V-JEPA 2 final-layer embedding

sound:mid:mean.what: mean over windows of the EAT middle-layer (block 6 of 12) embedding

sound:mid:mean+std.what: EAT middle layer: mean and per-dimension std over windows

sound:last_c:mean.what: EAT last layer; each window minus the corpus mean (mean of film means), L2-normalised, then averaged

sound:last_c:mean+std.what: as sound:last_c:mean, with the per-dimension std over windows appended

sound:stats.what: loudness (RMS dB, clipped at -80) and log spectral centroid over windows: mean, std, p10, p90 of each; z-scored across films

sound:mid:mean+stats.what: sound:mid:mean and sound:stats concatenated, each scaled to the same total variance

words.what: mean of multilingual-e5-small transcript chunk embeddings; films with capped speech share under 0.05 left out

fused.what: look:mean + time + sound:mid:mean, each normalised on the shared films and scaled to equal total variance, concatenated

fused:look+time.what: look:mean + time, each normalised on the shared films and scaled to equal total variance, concatenated
